text: HDAC4 nuclear translocation was higher in ApoE4 than in ApoE3 astrocytes, suggested as the basis for NHE6 down-regulation upstream of endosomal hyperacidification.
description: ApoE4 vs ApoE3 astrocytes; source not given in the abstract (abstract-only). Caveat: an upstream intermediate, distant from endosomal pH.

provenance.excerpt: Increased nuclear translocation of histone deacetylase 4 (HDAC4) in ApoE4 astrocytes, compared with the nonpathogenic ApoE3 allele, suggested a mechanistic basis for transcriptional down-regulation of NHE6.

meccogFinding.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (increased HDAC4 nuclear translocation) -> (lower NHE6 transcription) -> (lower endosomal pH)
